input:
Labeled defect
- root cause: Argument.get_help_record returns self.help unchanged, so the second element of the tuple is None for an undocumented argument even though format_arguments now feeds every record straight into formatter.write_dl without a fallback.
- failure path: A command declares two arguments and sets help on only one; running it with --help makes write_dl measure and wrap a None description and the help command crashes with a TypeError instead of printing usage.

Reviewer finding
- description: get_help_record now always returns a tuple, but when self.help is None it returns (metavar, None) instead of an empty description as the docstring promises. The previous fallback to an empty string was removed.
- rationale: Trigger: a command where at least one Argument has help set and another has help=None, which is the normal case. format_arguments passes every record to formatter.write_dl, which processes the second element as text (wrapping/len), so None raises a TypeError or AttributeError. The result is that --help crashes for such commands.
critique: The finding names the same mechanism: get_help_record returns None as the description for an argument with no help, and format_arguments passes it to write_dl, which then fails with a TypeError when processing it as text. It also gives the same trigger, mixed documented and undocumented arguments, and the same result, --help crashing.
